title: Concepto de Empaque Premium de Yuzu Cítrico Japonés: Póster de Producto Editorial Minimalista
prompt: Premium Japanese-style product poster in 16:9 landscape format, editorial design showcasing yuzu citrus juice skin packaging concept with sophisticated visual storytelling. LEFT SIDE (40% of canvas): Hero product - one large yuzu juice skin package displayed vertically with dramatic soft lighting, showing ultra-realistic yuzu peel texture wrapped around rectangular container, textured golden-yellow skin with natural bumps and dimples covering entire surface, rough organic texture with subtle oil glands visible, looks exactly like real yuzu citrus skin stretched over package. Below: one cross-sectioned fresh yuzu showing pale yellow creamy flesh with seeds. Japanese typography vertically aligned: 柚子スキン (Yuzu Skin) in elegant thin gothic font. Subtitle: 果汁皮膚 / 柚子 in refined style. Small design philosophy text in Japanese. CENTER (30% of canvas): Generous white negative space (Ma - 間), minimal geometric elements with delicate thin lines, floating text: 自然な素材 (natural materials), subtle minimalist brand mark, very subtle yuzu peel texture pattern in background at low opacity. RIGHT SIDE (30% of canvas): Two yuzu juice skin packages arranged artistically at different angles and heights, one whole fresh yuzu with natural textured golden skin, typography: Natural Packaging / 自然な包装, tagline: The skin is the package / 皮膚が包装である, detail callouts pointing to textured peel surface. DESIGN PRINCIPLES: Abundant white space, asymmetrical balance, Wabi-sabi aesthetic, Muji/Noritake editorial minimalism. COLOR PALETTE: golden yuzu tones, pure white background, pale yellow accent from flesh. PHOTOGRAPHY: Soft diffused studio lighting, ultra-sharp macro details showing textured peel, photorealistic rendering. CRITICAL: The yuzu skin packaging must look incredibly realistic - actual organic textured golden-yellow surface with natural bumps and oil glands, rough natural appearance, NOT plastic. 16:9 widescreen, high-end Japanese product poster, gallery quality.
